entries.title: PHB and DMG discovery census
entries.description: A bounded 370-page PHB/DMG discovery census recorded 52 page/group claims and 18 discovery-only table groups. None of those new table groups has been transcribed row by row. Text-screened noncandidate and unreviewed pages do not establish that no price exists. This is a monetary discovery census, not a source-row transcription or whole-book semantic completeness claim. The 370-page denominator counts only the PHB and DMG PDFs. The separate DMG printed-p.175 image is a supplement and is excluded from that count. Counts distinguish screened pages, visually screened thumbnails, and previously inventoried scoped pages; these are not interchangeable denominators. Starting wealth, currency conversion, ordinary purchase prices, hireling wages, service fees, construction costs, spell/component costs, treasure generation, market valuations and item values are typed separately rather than treated as equivalent “prices.” Any exact amount in discoverySummary or locatorAmountCue is a locator note only pending source-scale verification; it must not be consumed as a normalized/verified source fact.

entries.title: UA discovery census
entries.description: A bounded 130-page UA census recorded 65 discovery claims and 15 table-level groups; no new table group is transcribed row by row. The basic equipment table is covered by a separate scoped inventory. The source census is additional to the existing p.26 equipment table inventory; that page is not duplicated. No whole-book visual-completeness claim: many noncandidate pages are text-screen-only and OCR/text screening can miss currency values. Table rows and object/value pairings for the random magic-item price tables are not fully transcribed. Bounds are deliberately whole-page and page-level only. Every recorded claim was visually associated with its source page, but fine-grained claim-specific rectangles were not measured. The printed-p.97 continuation has a visible value but unresolved object identity. Sale value, component value, creation price, repair fee, treasure cap, behavior threshold, weight, and starting wealth remain typed distinctly; they are not interchangeable claims.

entries.title: Monster book discovery census
entries.description: A bounded MM/MMII census screened 276 PDF pages and recorded 63 visually reviewed claims plus 4 unresolved candidates. This inventory does not define a table-group denominator or claim whole-book completeness.
